name: assay
description: Audit Claude Code telemetry: what was captured, whether it agrees with itself, and a hash-proof of each API request. Local-only, deterministic, no model in any verdict.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @assay/core build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm schema:check && pnpm claims && pnpm public-check
scripts.web: pnpm --filter @assay/core build && pnpm --filter @assay/cli build && pnpm build:web && node packages/assay-cli/dist/cli.js export-site web/prototype/site-runs.json --out web/prototype/data.js --results results
